title: serratula carthamoides
intro: Serratula carthamoides, commonly known as Red Mallow or Carthamoid Serratula, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing pain and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Serratula carthamoides are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Research has shown that the bioactive compounds present in Serratula carthamoides may also possess hepatoprotective and immunomodulatory effects.
